headline: GCC Secretary General: Gulf Sovereign Wealth Fund Assets Reach $5.2 Trillion
summary: The GCC Secretary General said assets of Gulf sovereign wealth funds have reached $5.2 trillion. The figure was reported by Manchete, citing the statement.
why: Gulf sovereign wealth funds are among the largest pools of state capital globally, and their allocations influence global equity, real estate and private-markets flows.
